# metadata.HEALPyxelxMetadata { #healpyxel.metadata.HEALPyxelxMetadata }

```python
metadata.HEALPyxelxMetadata(
    nside,
    order='nested',
    npix=None,
    mode='fuzzy',
    lon_convention='0_360',
    file_type=None,
)
```

Validated HEALPix grid metadata with embedded parquet I/O.

Central metadata class for all healpyxel pipeline files. Encodes the
HEALPix configuration (nside, order, mode, lon_convention) and provides
serialization to/from parquet schema metadata and companion JSON files.

All aggregate/sidecar parquet files embed this metadata in their Arrow
schema to ensure metadata/data consistency across the pipeline.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name           | Type             | Description                                                                                                                  |
|----------------|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| nside          | int              | HEALPix resolution parameter (must be a power of 2).                                                                         |
| order          | str              | Pixel ordering scheme: ``'nested'`` or ``'ring'``.                                                                           |
| npix           | int or None      | Total number of pixels. Auto-computed from ``nside`` if None.                                                                |
| mode           | str              | Cell assignment mode: ``'strict'`` or ``'fuzzy'``.                                                                           |
| lon_convention | str              | Longitude convention: ``'0_360'`` or ``'-180_180'``. Value ``'minus_plus180'`` is accepted and normalized to ``'-180_180'``. |
| file_type      | FileType or None | Pipeline stage that produced this file.                                                                                      |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> meta = HEALPyxelxMetadata(nside=32, order='nested')
>>> meta.npix
12288
>>> meta.nest
True
```

### from_dict { #healpyxel.metadata.HEALPyxelxMetadata.from_dict }

```python
metadata.HEALPyxelxMetadata.from_dict(d)
```

Parse from nested or flat metadata dictionary.

Supports both nested structure (from JSON sidecars with
``{'sidecar_metadata': {'healpix': {...}}}``) and flat dicts
(direct HEALPix keys at the top level).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                   | Default    |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| d      | dict   | Dictionary with HEAPix parameters. May be nested (JSON sidecar metadata) or flat (parquet-embedded metadata). | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type               | Description                                   |
|--------|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
|        | HEALPyxelxMetadata | Validated instance with all fields populated. |

### from_parquet { #healpyxel.metadata.HEALPyxelxMetadata.from_parquet }

```python
metadata.HEALPyxelxMetadata.from_parquet(path)
```

Extract metadata from parquet schema or companion JSON.

Tries embedded parquet metadata first, falls back to .meta.json file.

Args:
    path: Path to parquet file

Returns:
    Parsed HEALPyxelxMetadata

Raises:
    ValueError: If no metadata found
